review_samples.author: Rodger Pierre
review_samples.text: Here we are again 6 years later we got more bees, much easier this time around though. Local bee keeper (Homestead) was great, highly educational, easy to understand, explained the whole process, bees, removal, relocation, the reproductive process, amazing, nice guy, easy to work with. Mrs P.

review_samples.author: George Graquitena
review_samples.text: The folks over at A Team were top notch! I had a bad bee problem in the wall of my house, and they came out and did a great job taking care of it! Very professional, friendly, great attitude and incredibly helpful! They are lifesavers!

review_samples.author: Oscar B
review_samples.text: The folks at A Team Wildlife Removal & Bee Removal Miami were great! Quick response and easy to evaluate my issue virtually. They came out to see me within the hour! Would definitely recommend for your local needs!

review_samples.author: Gladys
review_samples.text: A Team Wildlife Removal & Bee Removal Miami is AWESOME! The team members are proven experts in their field and extremely professional. They did a GREAT job with my bee removal and I highly recommend their services. Thank you very much for a great job well done!

review_samples.author: Michael Kilgore
review_samples.text: The Beekeepers @ A Team Wildlife Removal & Bee Removal Called Gary and responded very fast. Resolved my issue, and was able teach me a thing or two. He will be only person I'll call with any critter problems.
